description: Sixteen voltage sources with sixteen stored scenes, and a fader that morphs the whole set from one scene to another

params.text: Chooses the scene being morphed from, 0 to 15
Chooses the scene being morphed towards, 0 to 15
Morphs between the two scenes, the current scene at the bottom of its travel and the target scene at the top
Jumps to the target scene, taking the morph to the top of its travel and returning every control that was moved by hand to the stored value
Jumps to the current scene, taking the morph to the bottom of its travel and returning every control that was moved by hand to the stored value
Stores the sixteen control values into the scene selected as current
Shifts every output down by 5V, turning a 0V to 10V range into -5V to +5V
Fills the target scene with random values and randomizes which controls morph and which jump
Switches that control between morphing smoothly across the fader's travel and jumping to the target value only when the fader reaches the top; the lamp is lit for jumping
Sets that control's value; moving it takes the control out of the morph until the scene is jumped to again

inputs.text: 0V to 10V adds to the target scene number, 1.5 scenes per volt
0V to 10V adds to the current scene number, 1.5 scenes per volt
Added to the morph fader, 10V being the whole travel

outputs.text: The voltage of that control, 0V to 10V, or -5V to +5V with the range switch down

menu: Randomize target scene only — fills the scene selected as target with random values and randomizes which controls morph and which jump, leaving the other scenes alone

inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
